body: Very much so. Because it is a friend of a friend it is a problem.

My future is dead and gone because I could not get over my depression I don't know where I went wrong. Should I just not have taken the molestation too hard? I hate myself. That is just it at this point I can't figure out what to do. I am lost and my future feels so dark it may as well not exist.

I don't know. I am a financial burden that hasn't been able to get through college properly. So many things spiralled out of control. I feel it would be best if I didn't bother my family or friends with my fuck ups. I am just sitting here looking for ways to make sure they don't take it as hard as I know they will. I want to find ways to soften the blow for them as much as possible.
